commands.cmd: p=$(command -v ccusage) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && ccusage --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" ccusage

F=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
mkdir -p "$F/cfg/projects/-tmp-ccusage-fixture-mac" "$F/empty/projects" || exit 1
python3 -c "
import json,sys
def row(i,ts,inp,out,cw,cr):
    return {'parentUuid':None,'isSidechain':False,'userType':'external','cwd':'/tmp/ccusage-fixture-mac','sessionId':'mcc-ccusage-fixture-session','version':'2.1.278','type':'assistant','uuid':'u'+str(i),'timestamp':ts,'requestId':'req_mcc_'+str(i),'message':{'id':'msg_mcc_'+str(i),'type':'message','role':'assistant','model':'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929','content':[{'type':'text','text':'fixture'}],'usage':{'input_tokens':inp,'output_tokens':out,'cache_creation_input_tokens':cw,'cache_read_input_tokens':cr}}}
rows=[row(1,'2026-01-15T10:00:00.000Z',100,20,300,4000),row(2,'2026-01-15T11:00:00.000Z',50,10,0,6000),row(2,'2026-01-15T11:00:00.000Z',50,10,0,6000),row(3,'2026-01-16T09:00:00.000Z',7,3,0,0)]
open(sys.argv[1],'w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':'))+chr(10) for r in rows))
" "$F/cfg/projects/-tmp-ccusage-fixture-mac/mcc-ccusage-fixture-session.jsonl"
rc1=$?
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$F/cfg" ccusage claude daily --json --offline --timezone UTC --since 20260101 --until 20260131 > "$F/daily.json"
rc2=$?
exact_ok=$(python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));k=('inputTokens','outputTokens','cacheCreationTokens','cacheReadTokens','totalTokens')
got={r['date']:tuple(r[x] for x in k) for r in d['daily']};tot=tuple(d['totals'][x] for x in k)
want={'2026-01-15':(150,30,300,10000,10480),'2026-01-16':(7,3,0,0,10)};wt=(157,33,300,10000,10490)
print('True' if (got==want and tot==wt) else 'False')
" "$F/daily.json")
since_out=$(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$F/cfg" ccusage claude daily --json --offline --timezone UTC --since 20260116 --until 20260131 | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);r=[(x['date'],x['totalTokens']) for x in d['daily']];print('True' if r==[('2026-01-16',10)] else 'False')")
empty_out=$(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$F/empty" ccusage claude daily --json --offline --timezone UTC | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('True' if (not d['daily'] and d['totals']['totalTokens']==0) else 'False')")
rm -rf "$F"
echo "SUMMARY fixture_build_rc=$rc1 ccusage_rc=$rc2 exact_match=$exact_ok since_narrows=$since_out empty_dir_zero=$empty_out"
echo "fixture per-day/totals equal to hand-computed values with the repeated message counted once: $exact_ok"
echo "--since 20260116 keeps only the second day: $since_out"
echo "an empty projects directory produces zero rows and zero tokens: $empty_out"
test "$rc1" -eq 0 && test "$rc2" -eq 0 && test "$exact_ok" = "True" && test "$since_out" = "True" && test "$empty_out" = "True"

fixture per-day/totals equal to hand-computed values with the repeated message counted once: True

commands.cmd:
t=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); y2=$(date -u -v-2d +%Y%m%d 2>/dev/null || date -u -d '2 days ago' +%Y%m%d); out=$(ccusage claude daily --json --offline --no-cost --timezone UTC --since "$y2" --until "$t"); ccrc=$?; printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
ccrc = int(sys.argv[1])
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
rows = d.get('daily', [])
totals = d.get('totals', {})
row_fields = sorted(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []
totals_fields = sorted(totals.keys())
keys = ('inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'cacheCreationTokens', 'cacheReadTokens')
per_day_ok = all(sum(r.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == r.get('totalTokens') for r in rows)
grand_ok = sum(totals.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == totals.get('totalTokens')
has_cost = 'totalCost' in totals or any('totalCost' in r for r in rows)
ok = ccrc == 0 and len(rows) >= 1 and per_day_ok and grand_ok and not has_cost
print('SUMMARY exit=%d rows=%d per_day_ok=%s grand_ok=%s has_cost=%s' % (ccrc, len(rows), per_day_ok, grand_ok, has_cost))
print('row field names (printed, not asserted):', row_fields)
print('totals field names (printed, not asserted):', totals_fields)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
" "$ccrc"
